notes: The margins *are congealed like stone* and the literal *cohereth* were read and set aside (rule 38).

*and become* could be taken as one added unit; the coordinator and the supplied verb are marked separately since each answers to nothing on its own — no conjunction morpheme stands (rule 14) and the Hebrew writes no second predication for *become* to link (rule 20).
The assimilated article of `כָּאֶבֶן` is `unrepresented` because the ASV writes no *the* for the phrase (rule 29).
